hooks.command: command -v kmctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; out=$(kmctl briefing --format antigravity 2>/dev/null) && printf '%s\n' "$out" || echo '{}'; exit 0

in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | grep -Eq '"executionNum"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*0([^0-9]|$)' || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; cd .. 2>/dev/null && [ -f .agents/hooks/okf-skills/hooks/okf-stop-check.sh ] || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; out=$(printf '{}' | bash .agents/hooks/okf-skills/hooks/okf-stop-check.sh 2>/dev/null); case "$out" in *'"decision":"block"'*) printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed 's/"decision":"block"/"decision":"continue"/';; *) echo '{}';; esac; exit 0
